entry.title: Private Kingdom Stewardship
entry.what_to_do: Enter your private kingdom and review its resource stores and live build timer.

steps.title: Castle Stewardship
steps.what_to_do: Review your resource stores and the live build timer.

steps.title: Raise the Town Hall
steps.what_to_do: Open construction and complete the approved Town Hall build.

steps.title: Future Commands
steps.what_to_do: Locate Research and Troops in the kingdom dock; both may remain locked.

steps.title: Construction Dock
steps.what_to_do: Open the construction dock. Keyboard B works only in your private kingdom.

steps.title: Castle & Areas
steps.what_to_do: Preview your inner-realm Castle, Area I, and Area II.

steps.title: Return to Adventure
steps.what_to_do: Use Shared Menu to return to your inner-realm adventure.
